description: Three Claude Code business systems: cold outreach, AI recommendation via llms.txt, and markdown mirrors.

sections.title: Three Systems. One Playbook.
sections.markdown:
# The Claude Code Business Playbook

Three complete systems any business owner can build with Claude Code.

## Systems

1. **The Cold Outreach Engine**  
   Find local businesses, score them, write personalized emails with AI, and send them automatically every morning.

2. **The AI Recommendation System (llms.txt)**  
   Make ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity recommend your business when customers ask.

3. **Markdown Mirrors**  
   Give AI a clean, plain-text version of every page on your site so it can quote you faster, more accurately, and more often.

sections.title: System 1 - The Cold Outreach Engine
sections.markdown:
# System 1 - The Cold Outreach Engine

Find businesses -> score them -> write personalized emails -> send them automatically.

## Intro

Brycen says he built this cold outreach system by talking to Claude Code, without a developer, agency, or monthly software stack.

## What You'll Build

By the end, you'll have a system that:

1. Finds local businesses in your area that might need your service
2. Scores each one on a 0-100 scale based on how likely they are to buy
3. Writes a personalized email to each business by reading its website
4. Sends emails automatically every morning
5. Follows up on a timed sequence
6. Detects replies and shows who responded

## Flow

Find Leads -> Score Them -> Write Emails -> Send Automatically -> Follow Up -> Detect Replies

## Prerequisites

- Claude Code installed on your computer
- A Gmail account for your business with an App Password
- A lead list in CSV format
- An Anthropic API key

## Cost

- About $5-$10 to draft 1,000+ emails via Anthropic API
- Gmail is free
- Claude Code subscription referenced as $20/month

sections.title: System 1 - Step 1 - Set Up Your Project
sections.markdown:
## Step 1 - Set Up Your Project

Paste this into Claude Code:

```text
I'm building a cold outreach system for my business. Here's what I do:
Business: [YOUR BUSINESS NAME]
What I sell: [YOUR SERVICE - e.g., "commercial vehicle wraps", "HVAC installation", "landscaping services"]
Location: [YOUR CITY, STATE]
Service area: [CITIES/COUNTIES YOU SERVE]
My ideal customers are:
- [INDUSTRY 1 - e.g., "roofing companies"]
- [INDUSTRY 2 - e.g., "plumbing companies"]
- [INDUSTRY 3 - e.g., "HVAC companies"]
I have a CSV file of local businesses with columns for: company name, email, phone, city, state, website, industry, reviews count, and reviews rating.
Create a project folder structure for this cold outreach system. I need:
- A folder for my raw lead data (CSV files)
- A folder for scored/processed leads (JSON)
- A folder for email drafts
- A folder for send logs
- A main scripts folder
Set this up and create a CLAUDE.md file that explains the project so future sessions have context.
```

sections.title: System 1 - Step 2 - Build the Lead Scoring Engine
sections.markdown:
## Step 2 - Build the Lead Scoring Engine

Paste this into Claude Code:

```text
Build me a lead scoring script in Python. Here's how I want it to work:

Read all CSV files from my raw leads folder. For each business, score them on a 100-point scale using these categories:

INDUSTRY FIT (20 points max):
- [YOUR TOP INDUSTRIES] = 20 points (best fit for my service)
- [YOUR SECOND TIER INDUSTRIES] = 14 points
- [YOUR LOWER PRIORITY INDUSTRIES] = 8 points

GEOGRAPHY (15 points max):
- [YOUR PRIMARY CITY/COUNTY] = 15 points
- [YOUR SECONDARY AREA] = 13 points
- [BROADER REGION] = 8 points
- Out of area = 2 points

BUSINESS SIZE SIGNALS (30 points max):
- Look for keywords in company name that suggest size (fleet, services, systems, enterprises, group = likely bigger)
- Multiple locations = more points
- High review count = established business = more points
- Has "Inc", "LLC", "Corp" in name = more points

DIGITAL PRESENCE (10 points max):
- Has a website = points
- Has reviews = points
- High review rating (4.0+) = points

After scoring, assign grades:
- 55-100 = Grade A (top priority)
- 35-54 = Grade B (solid leads)
- 0-34 = Grade C (lower priority)

Save the output as a dated JSON file with all the original info plus the score breakdown.
Disqualify any lead that has no email AND no phone number.
Sort the output by score, highest first. Print a summary at the end showing how many A's, B's, and C's.
```

sections.title: System 1 - Step 3 - Write Personalized Emails with AI
sections.markdown:
## Step 3 - Write Personalized Emails with AI

Paste this into Claude Code:

```text
Build me an email drafting script that uses the Claude API to write personalized cold emails.
```

sections.title: System 1 - Step 4 - Set Up Auto-Sending
sections.markdown:
## Step 4 - Set Up Auto-Sending

Send via Gmail SMTP with --limit, --dry-run, and --yes flags. Log every send. Never send to the same person twice.

sections.title: System 1 - Step 5 - Add Follow-Up Sequences
sections.markdown:
## Step 5 - Add Follow-Up Sequences

Day 3-5, 7-11, 14-18, 21-26 follow-up sequence with Re: threading, reply detection, and --dry-run support.

sections.title: System 1 - Step 6 - Detect Replies
sections.markdown:
## Step 6 - Detect Replies

Connect to Gmail, classify replies as POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/BOUNCE, log results, skip bounces in future sends.

sections.title: System 1 - Results and Tips
sections.markdown:
## Results

- 1,213 businesses scored and emailed
- ~$8 in API calls
- 15 emails/day on autopilot
- Zero coding experience required

sections.title: System 2 - The AI Recommendation System
sections.markdown:
# System 2 - The AI Recommendation System (llms.txt)

Make ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity recommend your business by name.

sections.title: System 2 - Step 1 - Create Your llms.txt File
sections.markdown:
## Step 1 - Create Your llms.txt File

Business details -> structured llms.txt with About, Services/Pricing, Locations, Contact, Service Area, Key Facts, What Makes Us Different, FAQ.

sections.title: System 2 - Step 2 - Upload It to Your Website
sections.markdown:
## Step 2 - Upload It to Your Website

File must live at yourwebsite.com/llms.txt

sections.title: System 2 - Step 3 - Add Schema Markup
sections.markdown:
## Step 3 - Add Schema Markup

JSON-LD: LocalBusiness, FAQPage, Service. Validate at validator.schema.org.

sections.title: System 2 - Step 4 - Open the Door for AI Crawlers
sections.markdown:
## Step 4 - Open the Door for AI Crawlers

Allow: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot in robots.txt.

sections.title: System 2 - Step 5 - Add a Real FAQ Section
sections.markdown:
## Step 5 - Add a Real FAQ Section

8-10 questions starting with how/what/where/when/why/do. Wrap in FAQPage schema.

sections.title: System 2 - Step 6 - Build Location and Service Pages
sections.markdown:
## Step 6 - Build Location + Service Pages

Location pages at /locations/[city]/ and service pages at /services/[service]/. Real content, schema, internal links.

sections.title: System 2 - Step 7 - Test It
sections.markdown:
## Step 7 - Test It

Ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overview: 'who does the best [service] in [city]?'

sections.title: System 2 - Results and Tips
sections.markdown:
## Results

- Traffic: ~7/day -> ~100-150/day (~1,400% increase)
- ChatGPT recommended the business by name

# System 3 - Markdown Mirrors

Give AI a clean version of every page on your site to read.

sections.title: System 3 - Step 1 - Build the Generator Script
sections.markdown:
## Step 1 - Build the Generator Script

Python script using BeautifulSoup + markdownify. Walk site folder, strip nav/footer/scripts, convert to clean markdown, write {page_dir}/index.md with frontmatter.

> Note: Source PDF cuts off near end of this prompt.
